## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest` and `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for logic changes
- [ ] Screenshot attached for UI changes
- [ ] Docs updated (README, `docs/`, `CLAUDE.md`) where the change affects them
- [ ] Nothing changes the audio samples unless it's opt-in and off by default
